# Fenrir PSA

Professional services automation: the service desk and the business behind it. For service desks and MSPs running tickets, SLAs, time, projects, agreements and billing.

Fenrir PSA is one of the [Fenrir apps](../README.md): it runs on its own, with its own dashboard, from this
repository with `FENRIR_APP=psa`. It is free, self-hosted and released under the Apache License 2.0, as-is and
without support.

## What it does

- Service boards with statuses, types, SLAs and priorities from impact × urgency
- Email to ticket, round-robin assignment, workflow rules and optional AI triage
- Dispatch timeline, workload view, problems and a change calendar
- Time entries, weekly timesheets and manager approval
- Projects with tasks and budgets
- Companies with sites, contacts and configurations (a CMDB)
- Agreements (SLAs, covered work, included hours) and invoicing, with Xero sync
- Products and quotes, a knowledge base, and a client portal where customers raise and follow tickets

## Quick start

1. Fork this repository (or copy it into a private repository) and clone **your** copy onto a Linux server.
2. Point a domain name such as `psa.yourcompany.com` at the server.
3. Run setup and choose this app:

   ```bash
   deploy/setup.sh --app psa
   ```

   Setup asks for your domain, an administrator email and your organisation's name, writes `deploy/.env` with fresh
   secrets, and can build and start the server.
4. Open `https://psa.yourcompany.com` and sign in with the email and the password setup printed.

The [full guide](GUIDE.md) covers every step in detail, first use, each page, configuration, updates, backups and
troubleshooting.

## The dashboard

| Menu | Page | What it is for |
|---|---|---|
| Home | **Dashboard** | The app's headline numbers and a way into each of its pages. |
| Clients | **Companies** | Customers with their sites, contacts, agreements, configurations and service history. |
| Clients | **Configurations** | The CMDB: devices, network appliances, licences and services you look after, linked to tickets. |
| Clients | **Knowledge base** | Runbooks for the team and how-to articles for customers, with revision history, templates and automatic documentation. |
| Service desk | **Service board** | Tickets by board with SLAs, priorities from impact × urgency, and time tracked against agreements. |
| Service desk | **Dispatch** | Drag unassigned tickets onto an engineer's timeline. Drag bookings to move them. |
| Service desk | **Workload & changes** | Who is carrying what, which tickets are at SLA risk, open problems and the change calendar. |
| Service desk | **Time & timesheets** | Time entries roll into weekly timesheets, manager approval and agreement billing. |
| Business | **Products & quotes** | A product catalogue with cost and margin, and quotes you can print or send. |
| Business | **Agreements & billing** | Agreements set SLAs, covered work and included hours. Invoices follow the live device count, additions and billable time. |
| Admin | **Service settings** | Boards, statuses and types; workflow rules; email-to-ticket; AI triage. |
| Admin | **Settings** | Customers (tenants), users and roles, custom fields, region and holidays, webhooks, API credentials, approvals, the audit log and platform options. |

## Requirements

| Item | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Server | Linux (Ubuntu 24.04 LTS on amd64 recommended), 2 vCPUs, 4 GB RAM plus 4 GB swap, 40 GB SSD. The server image is the same for every app, so the first build still compiles the agents once (it takes a while; later builds reuse it). |
| Software | Docker Engine with buildx and Docker Compose 2.24.4 or newer, Git, curl, OpenSSL, Bash, Python 3. |
| Network | A domain name (DNS A record) pointing at the server; TCP 80 and 443 open; SSH restricted to you. |
| Signing | Not needed: this app has no device agents. |

## Not in this app

Device management (the **rmm** app) and security alerts (**av**). Tickets that those apps would open automatically are opened only when they run on the same server (the **complete** platform). To add another app later, switch to `FENRIR_APP=complete` (see [the guide](GUIDE.md#adding-more-apps-later)); your data is kept.
